name: deconstructed-duotone-poster
title_zh: 把任意图片拆解成留白双色海报版式
tagline_zh: 给一张图、一段文字或一个主题，自动生成杂志级双色印刷排版。支持 3:4 九宫格、4:3 六宫格、竖/横四联幅。
tagline_en: Turn any image, text theme, or image+subject into spacious editorial duotone prints. Fixed 3:4 nine-grid, 4:3.
desc_en: Deconstruct a supplied image, a text-only theme, or a source image plus a requested added subject into a spacious editorial duotone print. Support portrait 3:4 nine-square and vertical four-panel layouts, plus landscape 4:3 six-square and horizontal four-panel layouts, each with fixed coordinates, equal top/left/right paper margins, one shared exact-square tile template, and zero visible rectangul
why_zh: 不是滤镜，是排版引擎：坐标、边距、网格全部硬编码，输出即印刷稿。同一套方形瓦片模板复用所有布局。
why_en: Not a filter—a layout engine with hard-coded coordinates and margins. One shared square-tile template drives every layout, so.
limit_zh: 只处理静态位图输入（JPG/PNG），不读 SVG 或 PDF；输出为排版坐标与切图建议，不直接生成成品印刷文件。
limit_en: Input: raster only (JPG/PNG), no SVG/PDF. Output: layout coordinates + tile specs, not a print-ready file. Complex textures/gradients lose detail in.
